description: This file defines the WorkerPoolImplementation class, which inherits from core classes related to worker and thread pools, and includes an inner Dispatcher class for job dispatching. It sets up a worker pool with specific thread and queue sizes, and manages its lifecycle.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Implements a worker pool with a dispatcher for job execution, managing thread count and queue size.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Inner class responsible for dispatching jobs within the thread pool.

methods.name: WorkerPoolImplementation()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker pool with specified thread and queue sizes, and starts it.

methods.name: ~WorkerPoolImplementation()
methods.description: Destructor that stops the worker pool.

methods.name: Idle()
methods.description: Method intended to be called when the worker pool is idle; currently empty.
